name: VibeCoder — AI-Powered Cloud Web IDE
tagline: Next.js 15, WebContainers, Monaco Editor & Gemini 1.5 Flash powered cloud browser playground
purpose: A production-grade browser-based cloud development environment running full-stack Node.js applications (React, Next.js, Express, Hono, Vue, Angular) directly inside browser sandboxes without remote server VMs.
problem_solved: Local dev environment setup is slow, fragile, and hardware-dependent. VibeCoder boots isolated in-browser WebContainer micro-runtimes in milliseconds, complete with xterm.js terminal, Monaco editor, and Gemini 1.5 Flash AI error repair.

pipeline: AI Wrench Automated Terminal Stack Trace Error Repair
architecture.description: Browser-based cloud IDE leveraging StackBlitz WebContainers for client-side Node.js execution, Monaco Editor for multi-file code editing, and Gemini 1.5 Flash for context-aware code autocomplete and 1-click terminal error repair.
key_design_choices: WebContainers API over remote EC2/Docker containers for zero-cost instant browser execution
Gemini 1.5 Flash for <0.8s code completion latency (90%+ speedup over local LLMs)
AI Wrench automated stack trace interceptor for instant terminal bug fixes
Prisma ORM + MongoDB Atlas for persistent workspace storage and public sharing

key_achievements: In-browser Node.js micro-runtimes across 6 full-stack templates (React, Next.js, Express, Hono, Vue, Angular)
Context-aware Gemini 1.5 Flash AI autocomplete (<0.8s latency)
AI Wrench automated terminal stack trace error repair
1-Click Public GitHub Repository import into browser sandbox
Multi-tab Monaco Editor with 6 themes and xterm.js terminal emulator
